correctness.rationale: The full tent map folding of doubling gives exactly m=2^n distinct fixed points, one in each interval [j/m,(j+1)/m], in the two interlaced 2k/(m-1),2(k+1)/(m+1) grids. Increasing 1D coupling sends each interval to its grid point and is optimal for all p>=1. Summing offsets gives W1=(2m^2-1)/(6m(m^2-1)), W2^2=1/(6(m^2-1)), Winfty=1/m; the offsets approach two uniform grids, producing limit m^p Wp^p=2/((p+1)(p+2)). Convex interval p-cost gives unrestricted m-atom quantizer lower bound 1/[2m(p+1)^(1/p)]. Independently enumerated exact inverse branches and rational W1,W2,Winfty for n=1..8. Finite verification is corroboration, while the quantile proof establishes infinite n/fixed p.
